text:
maria: Nightly GPU smoke is red on the ptx-loader test. Job: https://ci.redwood/inference/90712 — anyone seen PTX checksum/CRC errors before? Logs below.

maria: ```
ptx-loader: ELF image checksum mismatch (expected 0x1a2b3c4d, got 0xdeadbeef)
cuModuleLoadDataEx() failed: CUDA_ERROR_INVALID_IMAGE: invalid PTX image
kernel launch aborted: invalid device function
```

infra-bot: Node gpu-h100-12 patched last night; driver versions vary across pool: some nodes 525.85, some 526.0. Job ran on node gpu-h100-12b (driver 525.85).

kevin: @maria thanks — that pattern smells like driver/cudart mismatch JITing a newer PTX. Which docker tag is the job using?

maria: It's redwood/gpu-smoke:cuda-12.2-2026-03-17. Matrix variant that failed: h100-12_2-driver-526 (but the node actually served 525.85). I can paste `ldd` output: `libcuda.so.1 -> /usr/lib/libcuda.so.525.85`

sam: Can we rerun on the pinned-driver pool? @dani do we have a homogeneous pool we can force this on?

dani: On it. We rolled a driver+kernel update last night to 526.0 and some nodes haven't been rotated. I'll schedule a rerun on gpu-homogeneous-526.

maria: If rerun clears, probably infra flakiness. If it repros, we should bisect across driver versions and also check ptx generation flags. I'll also try a local repro with the same image.

kevin: One other angle: our quantized-attention build flips a `--ptx-opt-level` flag which can change PTX output enough to hit `invalid device function` on older drivers. Worth checking the build flags for that matrix variant.

infra-bot: Rerun requested: https://ci.redwood/inference/retry/90712 by dani

dani: Rerun started on pool gpu-homogeneous-526, ETA ~20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: Appreciate it. If it's green I'll mark the test flaky and add a jittered restart to nightly. If it stays red I'll open a driver-bisect ticket and attach the failing artifact.

sam: I'll keep an eye on the job. ping here if you need me to grab the tarball or run a local repro.
